title: Divergent Catalytic Strategies of Group-6 Propane Monooxygenases in Propane-Stimulated 1,4-Dioxane Biodegradation.
authors: Yang, Junwon; Dhakal Gaudel, Devi Kumari; Antunes, Jose Manuel Diaz; Zheng, Wenwei; Li, Mengyan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究丙烷单加氧酶对1,4-二氧六环降解的催化差异，虽涉及蛋白结构分析，但核心是酶催化功能与生物修复，结构计算建模非主要贡献，仅部分相关。
abstract: Group-6 propane monooxygenases (PRMs) catalyze the initial oxidation of 1,4-dioxane (dioxane), a widespread contaminant of emerging concern. Because their expression can be induced by propane, an inexpensive and readily deliverable substrate, PRM-containing microorganisms offer a distinct advantage for propane-based biostimulation strategies targeting dioxane removal. However, functional differences among PRMs from the three major phylogenetic clusters remain poorly understood. Here, three PRMs from Mycobacterium dioxanotrophicus PH-06, Mycobacterium marinum E11, and Mycobacterium sp. ENV421, representing phylogenetic clusters, PRM-I, PRM-II, and PRM-III, respectively, were heterologously expressed in Mycolicibacterium smegmatis mc2155. ENV421 PRM-III exhibited low substrate affinity but high catalytic capacity toward both dioxane and propane, and moderate resistance to chlorinated solvent inhibition. In contrast, E11 PRM-II displayed high affinity but lower capacity and greater inhibitor sensitivity. PH-06 PRM-I showed comparatively stronger activity toward dioxane than propane relative to the other PRMs. Protein structure analysis suggested that variation in substrate affinity and catalytic turnover is consistent with differences in active-site pocket hydrophobicity, rigidity, and catalytic geometry. Phylogenetic and compositional analyses further suggested horizontal transfer in Clusters I and III. Together, these results highlight substantial functional diversity among group-6 PRMs and offer mechanistic insights for optimizing microbial populations for effective propane-stimulated bioremediation of dioxane.
abstract_zh: Group-6 propane monooxygenases (PRMs) 催化1,4-二噁烷（dioxane）的初始氧化，1,4-二噁烷是一种广泛存在的新兴关注污染物。由于它们的表达可被丙烷诱导，而丙烷是一种廉价且易于递送的底物，含有PRM的微生物为针对二噁烷去除的丙烷基生物刺激策略提供了明显优势。然而，来自三个主要系统发育簇的PRM之间的功能差异仍知之甚少。在此，来自Mycobacterium dioxanotrophicus PH-06、Mycobacterium marinum E11和Mycobacterium sp. ENV421的三种PRM，分别代表系统发育簇PRM-I、PRM-II和PRM-III，在Mycolicibacterium smegmatis mc2155中异源表达。ENV421 PRM-III对二噁烷和丙烷均表现出低底物亲和力但高催化能力，并且对氯化溶剂抑制具有中等抗性。相比之下，E11 PRM-II显示出高亲和力但较低能力以及更大的抑制剂敏感性。PH-06 PRM-I相对于其他PRM，对二噁烷表现出比丙烷相对更强的活性。蛋白质结构分析表明，底物亲和力和催化周转的变化与活性位点口袋疏水性、刚性和催化几何形状的差异一致。系统发育和组成分析进一步表明簇I和III中存在水平转移。总之，这些结果突出了group-6 PRM之间显著的功能多样性，并为优化微生物种群以实现有效的丙烷刺激二噁烷生物修复提供了机制见解。
